unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Reducing motion
drDigitalIntro:
Windows normally slide, fade and zoom as they open and close.
• Those animations look pleasant, but they make some people dizzy or queasy, and they slow down anyone who just wants the window there now.
• Reduce Motion switches them off. Windows simply appear and disappear.
• Nothing stops working — the computer does exactly what it did before, just without the movement.
• If you get motion sickness on a phone or in a car, this one is worth trying.

playgroundTask.goal: You turned off the window animations

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Click the switch next to Reduce Motion.

drDigitalSuccess: Open and close an app from the dock now — the window just appears, with no sliding.
drDigitalHint: Reduce Motion is the second switch in the Pointer and Motion card.
